title: Where Do We Go - Ayra Starr

lines.l: You leave me on, then I follow you blind
Where do we go from here?
I come and see you, back in Mercedes
I know the spot you want, I been here before
There we go, I tell my friends you're out of town
You don't need to know what we doing after hours
I'ma need that back, boy, my turn
Spin the block and I give us a try
All the time that you spend in my mind
Yeah, you love when I'm drunk of the wine
Then I call you out of line, yeah
You leave me on, then I follow you blind
Where do we go from here?
Working on the weekend like usual
